name: 條（符禺山葵狀）

identity.personality: Witty and confrontational; asymmetric brows and terse open retort.

source.evidence: 其草多條，其狀如葵，而赤華黃實，如嬰兒舌，食之使人不惑。
facts: The 符禺山 variant of 條 is mallow-like (葵).
Red flowers and yellow fruits, the fruit compared with an infant's tongue.
Distinct from 石脆山 same-name 條: chive-like, white flowers, black fruit. The project intentionally retains both variants.
The text attributes freedom from confusion; literary material, not a medical claim.
originalDesignChoices: A 21-year-old female route adjudicator, plum hair/wrap coat and facial identity.
Rounded lobed leaf ears, green forearms, paired body-grown red flowers and two yellow elongated botanical pods.
Exact botanical species, leaf/flower structure, human features and job are design choices; pods are not literal human tongues.

prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: transparent character collection PNG, a two-view identity sheet. Both attached images are the mandatory CURRENT DEPLOYED STYLE MASTERS, not the character identities to copy. Match their decisive near-black variable-width contours, sparse interior lines, tiny angular nose, warm peach skin, simple broad flat hair masses, muted opaque flat colors with only one hard-edged shadow tone. Eyes have flat colored iris ovals and pure black pupils, NO eye highlights, NO iris rings or texture. The lively tense brows and graphic mouth matter: do not turn this into calm polished commercial game illustration. No gradients, bloom, rim lighting, airbrush, rendered textures, sheen, painterly brushwork. Do not copy reference goggles, face, clothing or haircut.
Composition: exactly TWO depictions of the SAME original person at same scale, left straight FRONT, right THREE-QUARTER facing slightly left; fully visible head and all anatomy, thigh-up framing with hands and body traits in frame, generous transparent space separating figures, at least 6% outer transparent margin. Each person ends with a clean deliberate thigh crop. Identical face/hair/outfit/body features across views. Actual transparent alpha outside figures and in all gaps; no scenery, ground, backing panels, decorative floating leaves, label, text, logo or watermark. Characters fully clothed; handsome/beautiful youthful people with real organic yokai anatomy, not humans wearing plant accessories.
Subject: Tiao of Fuyu mountain / 條（符禺山葵狀）, an ORIGINAL beautiful 21-year-old female red-bloom route adjudicator. Youthful heart-shaped face with wider cheeks and pointed chin; short deep aubergine hair in a curved blunt pageboy with a triangular straight fringe (clearly unlike the reference bob). Flat ochre eyes, one eyebrow cocked high and the other lowered, mouth open in a witty dismissive retort. Fully clothed cream high-neck underlayer, muted plum wrap coat with mustard cuff edging and a dark olive plain waist sash; broad simple cloth blocks and minimal folds.
Actual plant body: BOTH ears are living rounded shallowly lobed green mallow-like leaves with a very simple radial vein structure, growing directly from the sides of her head in place of human ears; no extra human pinnae. On her exposed neck-to-shoulder junction grow two short living green stems that visibly emerge from the skin, each ending in a red flower with a few broad simple petals. Her visible forearms transition into living pale-green stems near the wrists. One forearm has a short attached stem bearing TWO yellow elongated soft rounded tongue-shaped fruits, clearly botanical pods, not literal human tongues, not lanterns or jewelry. Place one forearm across waist and other hand open beside torso so BOTH the red organic blossoms and yellow fruits can be identified in both views. Human hands end in five tidy fingers, no extra limbs. Flowers and pods belong to her body, no detached ornaments.
Source boundary: this is specifically the Fuyu mountain Tiao, described as mallow-like with red flowers and yellow fruits compared with an infant tongue. Do NOT confuse with the Shicui mountain same-name herb with white flowers and black fruit. Rounded leaf morphology, young woman identity, green skin transitions, exact flower/pod configuration and job are original design translations. No white flowers or black fruit. Keep foliage extremely simplified, strong flat shapes and near-black outlines; no delicate game-painting glitter, no glamour makeup.

review.summary: Both views show the same woman, red flowers, yellow pods and green forearms. Human ear visible beneath leaf ears, while flower stems looked tucked into collar rather than attached to skin. R02 targets plant/body junctions.
limitations: Residual human-ear outline at leaf root persists, especially right three-quarter; anatomy refinement pending.
Round leaves, stem junctions and green-arm facets are more detailed than the style-master portraits.
Requested outer transparent margin not fully reached at top hair and thigh crop.
This is specifically the red-flower/yellow-fruit Fuyu variant; no claim to modern species identification.
review.identityAcrossViews: same face/hair/clothing/palette observed in both views; expressions preserve live-series tension

officialConceptReference.evidence: Official homepage identifies the Onmyoji character lineage, several costume collections and shikigami names including 九命貓, 姑獲鳥 and 大天狗.
officialConceptReference.application: Human/yokai integration is a design interpretation prompted by the user. No game artwork controls rendering; the two live PNGs are the direct rendering references.

transparencyStatus: real_alpha_present; low/zero-alpha hidden RGB is preserved, not interpreted as an opaque background
